title: Jubilee V2.2.2 frame assembly
author: Joshua Vasquez, Machine Agency, University of Washington

preview.description: Derived visual approximation; not a fabrication file. Source geometry is retained for CAD exports.
preview.process: Split the single top-level build_plate_assembly from the other top-level children, then OpenCascade tessellation linear deflection 0.8 mm and angular deflection 0.5 rad, merged identical positions; static geometry simplified with meshoptimizer to target 900000 indices and relative error 0.002. The smaller bed mesh is not simplified.

modifications: STEP is retained byte-for-byte under gzip. Export applies a rigid rotation and translation; the build plate subassembly can additionally be translated vertically, while all other parts remain in their upstream positions. The viewer uses a simplified tessellation and a uniform illustrative material. Custom project components are separate from the upstream assembly.
limitations: Imported build-plate assembly bounds do not verify its mounting interfaces, fixture fit, tool reach, collisions, temperature, physical performance or laboratory operation.
